description: Star Wars: Battlefront II (2005) v1.1 Rerelease via Proton and gamescope
long: Star Wars: Battlefront II is a large-scale shooter set across the Star Wars galaxy, letting players fight as clones, droids, rebels, and Imperials in infantry and vehicle combat. It adds space battles, playable Jedi heroes, and a story-driven galactic conquest campaign. The game supports split-screen and online multiplayer modes.
